name: CAR-MIL
requirements_review: Controlled MIL_BASELINE port retained. All four original CAR backbones and L1/COS loss definitions; original100epoch Adam/cosine recipe and pre-TRAIN VAL AUC selector, including untrained epoch0 and no post-final selector. Native DSMIL instance loss and original TransMIL flattened attention retained explicitly. Private shuffle-generator/RNG/Adam/scheduler/minibatch recovery, optional original checkpoint binding; NumPy2/CPU timing/patient/locked-TEST adaptations disclosed. Full reference/source/wheel/release gates remain pending.

execution_profiles.recipe: factual CE + counterfactual effect CE + attention regularization

original attmil factual/CF network and L1 objective; full100epochs Adam2e-4/wd1e-5/cosine100; original pre-TRAIN VAL AUC selector and private shuffle generator; locked TEST, disclosed NumPy2/CPU timing repairs

native_recipe.scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR(T_max=100, eta_min=0), after each full TRAIN epoch
native_recipe.selection: VAL AUC before TRAIN, strict improvement over initial0

repairs: original EarlyStopping np.Inf becomes np.inf for NumPy2

fixed patient-disjoint TRAIN/VAL and locked TEST replace original default TEST-as-VAL
num_workers0 replaces original2 for exact recorded/recoverable loading
